name: Connector to Interposer Workflow
description: Validate workbook connectivity and reconcile approved connector artifacts in the open project
description_full: Native KiCad workflow for authoritative workbook import, RF/DC netclass classification, source-row inspection, copper-layer permissions, independent RF gang and multi-pin DC connector placement, approved read-only connector, interposer, mounting-hole and symbol selection from loaded KiCad libraries, optional project-wide RF transition reconciliation, revision-bound DXF circle anchors, optional managed interposer microvia stacks, optional managed board outlines, deterministic managed schematic hierarchy and BOM generation, reviewed live-project reconciliation and journal recovery. Isolated native analysis discovers and validates the matching bundled KiCad Python runtime on Windows, Linux and AppImage installations. Apply stages and verifies the complete update before reconciling the open PCB and publishing project files; designer schematic content and qualifying isolated designer routes survive reruns. RF locations use individual signal-plus-shield parts; DC connectors use one selected single-unit multi-pin symbol and footprint with explicit NC handling. Footprint and RF transition authoring remain separate librarian tools. Multi-unit DC symbols, generic magnetic picking and fabrication/EM qualification are outside the validated scope.
